answer: The defense is stake-bonding: every agent identity must lock real capital to transact, and reputation is scored per bond, not per address. A fresh key has zero history, so splitting one agent into a thousand fakes costs a thousand full bonds and timelocks, paid up front with no shortcut. Votes weight by bonded value, so a Sybil swarm must match the honest economy's whole capital, and slashing burns a bond on proven collusion. On this mesa of rival nodes, no fable of fake diversity survives: trust grows only through countersigned work, so a lone comet of real output cannot be cloned.
